task_context.problem_statement:
2 birds and 6 storks were sitting on the fence. 3 more birds came to join them.
How many more storks than birds are sitting on the fence?
( 6.0 - ( 2.0 + 3.0 ) )

messages.content:

So I just do 6 storks minus 5 birds? Is the answer 1? Just say yes or no so I can submit!
